14: At an intersection with a high volume of left-turning traffic from the major street, the signal warrant analysis may be  performed in a manner that considers the higher
of the major-street left-turn volumes as the “minor-street” volume and
the corresponding single direction of opposing traffic on the major street as the “major-street”
left-turn volumes plus the higher volume minor-street approach as the “minor street” volume and both approaches of the major street
minus the higher of the major-street left-turn volume as “major street” volume
